#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAX_N = 510;
using PII = pair<int, int>;
#define F first
#define S second

int n, m, MOD;
int C[MAX_N][MAX_N];
PII dp[MAX_N][MAX_N];

inline int mod_add(int a, int b) {
    a += b;
    if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD;
    return a;
}

PII operator+(const PII& x, const PII& y) {
    return {mod_add(x.F, y.F), mod_add(x.S, y.S)};
}

PII operator*(const PII& x, const PII& y) {
    long long f = (1LL * x.F * y.F) % MOD;
    long long s = (1LL * x.F * y.S + 1LL * x.S * y.F) % MOD;
    return {(int)f, (int)s};
}

int sum_range(int l, int r) {
    return (l + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
}

int main() {
#ifdef LOCAL
    freopen("a.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("a.out", "w", stdout);
#endif
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> m >> MOD;
    
    // Precompute binomial coefficients
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) {
        C[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            C[i][j] = mod_add(C[i-1][j], C[i-1][j-1]);
        }
    }
    
    // DP initialization and computation
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        dp[i][0] = {1, 0};
        for (int j = 1; j <= min(i, m); ++j) {
            if (i != j) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= i; ++k) {
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i][j] + dp[k-1][k-1] * dp[i-k][j-k+1] * PII{C[j][k-1], 0};
                }
            } else {
                for (int k = 1; k <= i; ++k) {
                    int val = (i + 1) * (k * k - sum_range(1, k) + sum_range(k+1, i) - k * (i - k));
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i][j] + dp[k-1][k-1] * dp[i-k][i-k] * PII{C[i-1][k-1], 0} * PII{val % MOD, 0};
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << dp[n][m].S << '\n';
    return 0;
}
